name: SparkplugRow
description: One virtualised Sparkplug tree row: group, edge node (status, problem badges, hover actions), device, or metric (value with unit, quality, flags, type, age, copy). Rows are keyboard-reachable tree items.

props.name: row
props.description: SparkplugTreeRow from build-sparkplug-tree (kind: group | node | device | metric).

props.name: nowMs
props.description: Reference now for relative ages (from the store snapshot).

props.name: isHighlighted
props.description: Flashes a node row revealed from a warning.

props.name: onToggleExpansion
props.description: (key) toggles a group, node or device row.

props.name: onRequestRebirth
props.description: (group, node) asks for a rebirth (confirmed by the caller).

props.name: onCopyMetricList
props.description: (node) copies the node's metric list as JSON.

notes: Figma is not linked yet; stories use local fixtures. Node actions are hover-revealed (same affordance as MqttTopicRow's broker-status button).
